newsitem.title: USA: Gunman killed in Colorado student hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: Gunman killed in Colorado student hostage drama.

text.p: An armed man who took three women university students hostage died after being shot by police on Tuesday, officials said. One of the students, believed to be the gunman's former girlfriend, was shot in the foot.

The gunman, apparently distraught over a breakup with his former girlfriend, took the women hostage in a dormitory at the University of Northern Colorado in Greeley, about 55 miles (90 km) north of Denver.
The shot student was listed in very stable condition at the North Colorado Medical Centre.
The unidentified gunman died later at the same hospital, a spokeswoman for the medical centre said.
Police in southwestern Colorado were reportedly seeking to talk with the gunman about a triple homicide in the small town of Bayfield, Colorado.
A spokeswoman at the Bayfield marshal's office declined to comment other than to say police would issue a statement on Tuesday night.
